messages:
alex (product): Heads-up from roadmap sync: telemetry ingestion and SLA trace sampling are blocking the milestone. Options: 1) ship MVP with basic billing metrics + 1% sampling turned off (low-cost), v1 adds full SLA tracing and 10% sampling; 2) keep full telemetry but slip date. Need quick call: prefer keep ship date.
jun (eng-sre): full tracing adds 2 infra stories (storage retention + realtime pipeline) that are risky in the window. We can ship with lightweight metrics (QPS, errors, p50/p95) and defer trace sampling.
mike (eng): note: some customers (pilot tier) expect SLO-level traces for debugging. We could offer a scoped "trace-on-demand" opt-in for up to 3 tenants, gated manually, until pipeline is hardened.
sara (data): trace-on-demand would still require a retention policy and backfill plan. We can keep traces ephemeral (48h) for pilot and keep long-term retention for v1. That halves infra work.
ellie (pm): ACME and Beryl pilots asked for traces during integration. If we offer trace-on-demand for them only, we likely keep pilots happy and keep general GA telemetry light. Need to lock owners and acceptance criteria.
alex (product): strawman decision: ship MVP on schedule with basic metrics; enable "trace-on-demand" for up to 3 pilot tenants (manual enable + 48h retention). v1 (T+11 days) adds full sampling, retention policies, and user-facing trace UI. Owners: jun -> manual enable runbook + alerts, sara -> retention + backfill safety, mike -> trace ingestion shim + toggle, ellie -> pilot coordination.
jun (eng-sre): will add gating: if telemetry ingestion error-rate >0.3% on canary, we abort trace-on-demand. Also add quota: trace-on-demand limited to 5% of tenant requests to avoid hot storage spikes.
sara (data): I'll prepare a small backfill script and a perf test `tools/trace_load_test --duration 30m --sample 5k` to validate pipeline before enabling any tenant.
mike (eng): implement toggle and a simple audit log entry when trace-on-demand is enabled for a tenant. We'll also emit metric `trace_on_demand_enabled` for ops. PR by EOD.
ellie (pm): I'll coordinate pilot schedule with ACME/Beryl and get sign-off that 48h retention is acceptable. We'll also add language in pilot docs to avoid implying GA.
notify-bot: deployment 9918 queued for release/mvp-telemetry. status: pending canary.
alex (product): decision captured. Action items: update roadmap, add telemetry gating checklist, publish pilot runbook, schedule v1 buffer (+11 days). :white_check_mark:
